nom: CeraVe Hydrating Sheer Sunscreen SPF 30 Face & Body Lotion

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily-leaning skin report the formula absorbs without leaving a greasy or shiny finish (e.g. i60, i78, i22).
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as hydrating, non-greasy and soothing, with one saying it sinks in quickly while keeping skin comfortable (i50, i56, i28, i44).
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one with rosacea and one with acne-prone combo skin, say it works well and doesn't feel heavy (i26, i31, i33).
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with rosacea, report no burning, no irritation and no increased redness, though one with sensitive combo skin still associated a breakout with CeraVe sunscreens generally (i48, i53, i58, i64, i4).
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 60s reports regret at not using it earlier on the body for photoaging, without reporting any negative reaction (i52).

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer says she wishes she had started applying it to sun-exposed areas earlier to prevent visible aging, and one reviewer reports it helped clear sun-induced hyperpigmentation.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including those with dry skin, describe the product as hydrating and moisturizing enough to skip a separate moisturizer; one dry-skin reviewer found it not hydrating enough for her face and prefers it on the body only.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or sensitive/reactive skin report no redness or burning after sun exposure; no reviewer reports increased redness from the product itself.
concerns.barrier: No reviewer explicitly discusses barrier repair, though several with sensitive or eczema-prone skin note no stinging or irritation.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her hyperpigmentation improved with use; no other reviewer specifically addresses spots or dark marks.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts or clogged pores; one reviewer with combo/sensitive/acne-prone skin suspects this sunscreen caused a breakout after a clear period.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers state it is non-greasy and doesn't leave an oily film, even under makeup; no reviewer reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Noticeable white cast on darker or fair skin

extraits.texte: Tried this on recommendation. Ugh. Leaves a white cast and is basically pointless in blocking the sun. Burned the first time using it. I had been using La Roche Posay and it had prevented burns, but this did nothing to prevent the sun. All the work I've done on my skin over the winter is now for naught.

I honestly want to love this sunscreen however the white cast it leaves is hard to deal with. I probably would have just continued using it despite the white cast because most everything els eahout it is amazing however my skin was clear and then consequently broke out after a week of using. This product is most wverything i want in a sinscreen, easy to blend, leaves you glowy, and is hydrating, while its difficult to know exactly what broke me out, ive had simular issues in the past with ceraveas sunscreens so im pretty sure thats the culprate. Its also not very high spf so maybe i wasnt applying often enough but it left me still burnt HOWEVER after applying it it will leave you looking like you havent seen the sunlight a day in your life because the white cast is so bad you just look pale. I wouldnt say dont buy this product bc theres lots of pros to it that i havent found in other sunscreens yet so honestly its a win loose with this product you just gotta pick your poison.

extraits.titre: Lightweight, no stinging, bang for your buck
extraits.texte: I was tired of spending so much on daily SPF for my face that came in such small tubes, so I hesitantly gave this a try. Its awesome. Im 22M with bad acne, eczema and sensitive combo skin, so good spf that doesnt burn or break me out is hard to find. This hits all my marks. Lightweight, glowy, no stinging or burning, doesnt clog pores and it has GREAT price per ounce value compared to other SPF. 10/10 forever recommend.

As a user but NOT lover of sunscreen, I have been pleasantly surprised at how nice the CeraVe Hydrating Sheer Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 30 for Face and Body has been to use! It's thin, almost milky consistency is not greasy, doesn't leave any type of noticeable finish on my skin, allows makeup to be easily applied on top, and best of it it hasn't caused my at-times sensitive, dry but acne prone skin to break out. It's large size will last a long time. I will definitely keep this one in my skincare lineup. 10/10 recommend.

This is my all time favorite sunscreen it is my go to last step of my morning skincare rountine. I worked with all my makeup products with making my skin feel heavy. Very hydrating i use it on my face neck and tattoos. I have very sensitive combo skin w rosacea and this product works great for me!

extraits.titre: Much needed Sunscreen for my sensitive face.
extraits.texte: I tried this CeraVe sheet sunscreen on my face for the first time when I knew I was going to be outside for a few hours tolling in the garden. I first noticed that once applied to my face it smoothed on and I didn't feel like it was just sitting in my pores clogging them. My face is very sensitive to products, so I have to be very careful. This sunscreen worked like a charm. 3 hours in the sun and no redness from a burn or from skin irritation. I would 100% recommend this. I have even put it under my foundation and it still feels light weight.

I love this sunscreen as Cera Ve is a respectable skin care company. I tried the Cetaphil sheer mineral sunscreen and it did NOT go on sheer. So, I went back for the Cera Ve. I use it on my arms and chest and neck. I wish I would have started doing that younger as I am 64 and have a lot of aging that can't be reversed : (
